veinminerplus.configuration.maxNormalBlo: Maximum normal chain blocks per tick

veinminerplus.configuration.maxNormalBlo: Maximum blocks mined by one normal or area chain job. Range: 1-2100000000.

veinminerplus.configuration.maxBlastBloc: Maximum blocks mined by one blast job. Range: 1-2100000000.

veinminerplus.configuration.noHungerCost: When enabled, automatically chained blocks do not consume hunger. Disabled by default. The manually mined first block keeps vanilla behavior.
